votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 02 of 2025 approving Housing Development Loan Program (HDLP) allocations for fiscal year 2024-25 for the Northwest Pipeline project funding.
votes.description: Approves up to a portion of $5.3 million in FY25 HDLP affordable housing allocations specifically for the Northwest Pipeline project, selected through a competitive NOFA issued in 2024. Director Mano was recused due to volunteer service on the Housing Authority Board/HAME.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 02 of 2025 approving Housing Development Loan Program (HDLP) allocations for fiscal year 2024-25 except the Northwest Pipeline project.
votes.description: Approves the remaining FY25 HDLP affordable housing allocations from the competitive NOFA issued in 2024, covering all proposed projects except the Northwest Pipeline.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 01 of 2025 approving the Accessory Dwelling Unit financing program allocation for fiscal year 2024-25.
votes.description: Approves $2.9 million in funding for the Community Development Corporation of Utah's ADU Financing Program, with approximately $1.9 million designated for the 9-Line Project Area and the remainder available citywide.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 03 of 2025 approving Citywide Affordable Housing project funding allocation for the residential Wealth-Building pilot program awarded to Community Development Corporation of Utah.
votes.description: Approves a portion of approximately $3.3 million in FY25 residential Wealth-Building NOFA funds allocated to the Community Development Corporation of Utah for affordable homeownership opportunities. Director Mano was recused from the Northwest Pipeline portion but participated in this vote.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 03 of 2025 approving Citywide Affordable Housing project funding allocation for the residential Wealth-Building pilot program awarded to the Housing Assistant Management Enterprise.
votes.description: Approves a portion of FY25 residential Wealth-Building NOFA funds allocated to the Housing Assistance Management Enterprise (HAME) for the Northwest Pipeline project. Director Mano was recused due to volunteer service on the Housing Authority Board/HAME.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 04 of 2025, approving the Commercial Development Loan Program with the exception of the aspect of the proposal enabling the finance committee to approve loans under five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000).
votes.description: Creates the Commercial Development Loan Program (CDLP) policy to replace the existing Loan Policy and Granary Adaptive Reuse Policy, expanding adaptive reuse to all CRA project areas and broadening applicant eligibility, but excluding the provision allowing the finance committee to independently approve loans under $500,000.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 05 of 2025, approving Pickle and Hide Mixed-Use Development tax increment reimbursement request with the additional requirement of water-wise landscaping, smart irrigation systems, and to the extent possible zero emission landscaping equipment.
votes.description: Approves a Tax Increment Reimbursement Agreement with Mountain West Development, LLC for Phase I and II of the Pickle & Hide mixed-use development in the 900 South HTRZ/Granary District, adding environmental conditions for water-wise landscaping, smart irrigation, and zero-emission landscaping equipment.
